title: Code and data for the literature review in "The problem with synergy"
description: Automated literature review estimating how many PubMed papers (2010-2025) present drug synergy as desirable: enumeration of all papers whose title or abstract uses a synerg* word, a random sample of 1,000 papers, classification with two large language models under five prompts, and the analysis behind the figures and supplementary tables of the article.
